tasks.label: fx-temp python-mt5 environment fingerprint
tasks.command:

import platform
import struct
import sys
import MetaTrader5 as mt5

'@; $fn = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'py_mt5_fingerprint.py'; Set-Content -Path $fn -Value $script -Encoding UTF8; python $fn
